entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one independent transparent achievement icon for a cozy pixel-art pasture mobile game.
Style: authentic simple 32-by-32-style pixel sprite expanded with hard square pixel clusters, warm cream sheep wool, terracotta/orange-brown dark outer contour, peach face, tiny dark eyes, simple green botanical accent. Match the project's friendly pastoral sheep achievement set: chunky stepped outline, few flat warm colors, adorable round sheep forms. Extremely simple bold shapes so the icon remains immediately recognizable when reduced to 28 pixels. No antialiased vector outline, no blurry painterly detail, no glossy 3D.
Composition: one compact central icon composition in a square canvas, subject occupies roughly 80 percent of the canvas, balanced transparent margins on all four sides; no clipping. Use genuinely transparent alpha outside the subject. The icon itself has no border, plaque background, badge shape, ground rectangle, or scenic backdrop. Large readable faces and minimal tiny detail.
Text: none. Absolutely no words, lettering, digits, captions, watermark, UI, or reference/contact sheet. Only ONE standalone icon, never an atlas or grid.
Subject: A cute cream-white fluffy sheep beside exactly two simple terracotta-brown hoofprints and one tiny green sprout; sheep dominant, footprints large enough to read, no path scenery.
